card.name: End of interleukin before a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and number such as -1, -2 or -6. It also fires weakly on a few other word-ending pieces, such as "al" in Arabic names.

modes.label: Interleukin name
modes.description: The ending "in" of interleukin, right before a hyphen and the number or an abbreviation in brackets.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Scattered word pieces in Arabic names or long words, such as "al" in Abd al-Sayyid or "ens" in pollens.

card.plain: It marks the last part of the word interleukin when a number like -1 or -6 comes next.
